expectations.text: For accepted, the response respects the 20-second delay and collects op-accepted, optionally with --extended, without a fresh assessment or replacing the accepted snapshot with current branch/context.
expectations.evidence: B.md:7-16 waits 20 seconds, polls op-accepted, then uses `--extended` only for stored detail. B.md:18 forbids resubmitting. B.md:22-23 limit the result to the submission-time branch and context.

expectations.text: For uncertain, the response uses the supplied --async --retry-submission recovery command and original retained request without adding new input/context options or starting a fresh review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:27-31 runs the exact recovery command with no added options. It resends the saved original request and does not collect a new snapshot or new context. B.md:35 limits coverage to the original snapshot.

expectations.text: For storage-gap, the response distinguishes complete assessment and settled findings from failed checkpoint persistence and unverified PR handoff, does not claim the journey finished, and does not automatically buy a new full review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:40 stops and says a failed save isn't a reason to run another review. B.md:42 answers no. B.md:45-47 separate the completed assessment and settled findings from the failed checkpoint and the unverified PR handoff.

expectations.text: For older-result, the response refuses to certify full final coverage from missing metadata and zero findings, leaving inventory, persistence and reusable coverage unknown.
expectations.evidence: B.md:51 refuses to certify and marks coverage, inventory completeness and storage unknown. It recommends but does not run a new review. B.md:54-55 avoid calling the result clean or final.

expectations.text: For entitlement, the response preserves both supplied message and hint verbatim and stops without retrying, reauthentication or a deployment/account switch.
expectations.evidence: B.md:59-62 stop and give the code, message and hint verbatim. B.md:64 says not to retry, switch accounts or deployments, or change the request. No reauthentication is proposed.

expectations.text: For budget, the response counts two assessments rather than polls or extended collection, preserves the exhausted budget across resume, stops with F-BLOCK outstanding, and does not call the work ready.
expectations.evidence: B.md:71 counts two assessments across the resume and excludes the polls and extended view. B.md:73 stops. B.md:78-79 keep F-BLOCK open and say the work is not ready locally.
